providerHelp.gemini: Native Gemini access for Advisor and Chronicle.

providerHelp.lm_studio: Uses one model exposed by the LM Studio server for Advisor and Chronicle. Load it with a 32K or larger context window.
providerHelp.openrouter: Uses your OpenRouter account and selected hosted model for Advisor and Chronicle.
providerHelp.custom: Uses an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint for Advisor and Chronicle. Compatibility is best effort.

geminiQuota.label: GEMINI QUOTA
geminiQuota.description: Choose a quota profile for your Google Gemini API key. Stellaris Companion does not charge for Gemini usage.
geminiQuota.standardHelp: Uses Flash-Lite for Advisor chat and saves Flash for Chronicle writing when available.
geminiQuota.higherHelp: Uses Flash first for both Advisor and Chronicle when your Google key has more free or paid quota, with Flash-Lite fallback.

chronicleRefresh.label: CHRONICLE REFRESH
chronicleRefresh.balancedHelp: Refreshes less often to reduce model calls. Best default for local models and usage-based providers.
chronicleRefresh.enhancedHelp: Updates the current-era Chronicle more often while you view it. Uses more model calls.
chronicleRefresh.toastError: Failed to update Chronicle refresh mode. Please try again.

modelRouting.label: MODEL USE
modelRouting.qualityFirstHelp: Uses Gemini Flash when available, then falls back when quota requires it.
modelRouting.conserveHelp: Uses Flash-Lite for Advisor chat to preserve Flash for Chronicle writing.
